title: Support tooling: add runbook links + customer-facing macros for marketplace onboarding issues
creator: Talia Benson
description:
Context
Marketplace launch readiness requires Support/CS to handle predictable onboarding issues quickly and consistently (entitlement lag, org linking mistakes, region mismatch, etc.). We already have a CS guide in Confluence, but it’s not discoverable at the moment of failure (Console onboarding wizard) and Support is currently copy/pasting ad-hoc responses.

Goal
1) Make the right internal runbooks discoverable from (a) Console onboarding error states and (b) internal support tooling (ticket view / sidebar links).
2) Provide a small, maintained set of customer-facing macros (AWS + GCP variants) that Support can use for first response + next steps.
3) Ensure macros and runbooks match the updated onboarding flows and don’t over-promise around security/compliance (copy must align with PMM/Security language).

Non-goals
- Re-platforming Support tooling or migrating ticket systems.
- Building a full self-serve support bot.

Proposed approach
A) Internal runbook surfacing
- Add a “Support runbook” link block to the Console marketplace onboarding wizard’s error states (behind the marketplace onboarding feature flag).
  - Target states: Entitlement pending, Org linking failed, Region mismatch, Webhook ingestion failure (generic), Metering not active.
  - Links should go to the canonical internal doc(s) (Confluence) with anchor links to specific sections.
- Add a short “Marketplace Onboarding” section to the internal support tooling (ticket sidebar / internal admin page) with:
  - Links: AWS runbook, GCP runbook, escalation policy, dashboards.
  - Quick copy buttons for support macros (see B).

B) Customer-facing macros
Create a macro set with templated fields (Customer org name, Cloud account/project ID, Marketplace purchase timestamp, Redwood org ID, region) and clear “what we need from you / what we’ll do next” structure.

Macro set (v1)
1) AWS entitlement activation delay
2) GCP entitlement activation delay
3) Linked to wrong Redwood org
4) Region mismatch (purchase region vs provisioned region)
5) Provisioning webhooks / entitlement ingestion issue (request IDs, timestamps)
6) Billing/invoice confusion (marketplace vs direct) — include handoff language to Finance/Legal but keep macro owned by Support

C) Ownership + maintenance
- Store macro source-of-truth in repo (docs-support/marketplace-macros.md) and sync into Support tooling via manual copy for v1.
- Add a quarterly review reminder tied to marketplace listing/security packet refresh cadence.

Acceptance criteria
- Console onboarding wizard error states (from ENG-4403) include an internal-only “Support runbook” link when viewed by Redwood staff (RBAC-gated) OR when the “support mode” toggle is enabled in admin.
- Support tooling page (internal) shows a Marketplace section with:
  - 3–5 key runbook links
  - dashboard link for entitlement lag + webhook failures (from ENG-4407)
  - escalation contacts and when to page SRE vs platform on-call
- Macros exist for the 6 categories above, reviewed/approved by Support lead (Dev Patel) and PMM (Soojin Lee) for tone and consistency.
- Macros include a standard “data we need” checklist and do not request sensitive materials unnecessarily (avoid asking for full invoices unless required).
- Dry run: Support readiness exercise completes with <10 min to send correct first response using the macros.

Implementation notes
- Console UI work should be minimal and piggyback on ENG-4403 (error state components). We can implement a small config mapping: error_code -> runbook anchor URL.
- Internal-only gating: keep URLs behind staff RBAC; do not expose Confluence links to end users.
- For customer-facing macros, include links to the public docs pages once ENG-4404/ENG-4405 land, plus a fallback to support@redwoodinference.com.

Links / references
- Confluence (CS/Support): Marketplace provisioning and troubleshooting guide
- Design spec: marketplace purchase → provisioning onboarding flow
- SRE dashboards/alerts: ENG-4407
- Console onboarding wizard: ENG-4403

Open questions
- Where should macros live operationally for v1: Zendesk macro library vs internal admin UI vs Jira templates? (Support currently uses Jira for some flows; confirm with Dev Patel.)
- Should we include a macro specifically for “Multiple AWS accounts / payer vs linked account confusion” (common in enterprise orgs)? If yes, swap in for #6 or add as #7.
comments: 2025-01-23 (Dev Patel): Top 3 ticket drivers from pilot buyers: (1) entitlement pending >30m, (2) wrong org linked, (3) GCP region mismatch. Macros should ask for purchase time + cloud account/project ID + screenshot of marketplace subscription page (NOT invoice) for faster triage.
2025-01-24 (Rafael Mendes): Please include dashboard link + what thresholds mean. We should page SRE only when entitlement lag p95 > 20m or webhook failure rate > 2% over 10m (align with ENG-4407).

2025-01-29 (Soojin Lee): Macro tone: avoid blaming cloud marketplace. Use: “We’ve received your purchase; entitlement activation can take a short period. Here’s what to check and what we’ll do in parallel.” Also: do not mention SOC2 details in macros; link to Security FAQ doc if needed.

2025-02-03 (Chloe Martin): Implemented internal runbook link block in Console onboarding error components behind staff RBAC. Waiting on final runbook URLs/anchors from Elliot/Kira to wire in mapping table.
2025-02-06 (Talia Benson): Aligning this ticket’s dry run with Support readiness session (ff-9062). Please have macros ready in a shareable doc by 2/10 so Dev can import into the ticketing system.
